tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Use this when a user asks for accommodation in Andorra, e.g. 'ski-in/ski-out hotel in Grandvalira', 'hotel with spa in Andorra', 'pet-friendly hotel in Canillo', 'family hotel in Soldeu or El Tarter', 'hotel with parking in Pas de la Casa'. Coverage today: parishes Canillo (Soldeu, El Tarter, Canill

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Use after search_hotels when the user wants details or a booking link for one property. Input: slug from search_hotels (e.g. 'hotel-nordic'). Returns every verified fact with its source URL and check date, notes from the official site, public contact, detected booking engine, record page, JSON API U

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Use to discover which parishes and localities have accommodation in the index (with counts) before filtering search_hotels by area, or to answer 'where can I stay in Andorra?'.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Generic search across entityindex.ai verticals; same data as the vertical-specific tools. Today the only vertical is 'hotels' (country 'andorra'); call list_verticals to see what exists. Parameters: vertical (required), country, area, query, filters (vertical-specific verified booleans; for hotels:

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Generic record lookup: vertical + slug (from search_entities). Same output as the vertical-specific get tool (e.g. get_hotel). Example: {"vertical":"hotels","slug":"hotel-nordic"}.

tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description: Lists the verticals (business types), countries and response languages (en, es, fr, ca) available in entityindex.ai, with their filters, URL pattern /{country}/{vertical}/{slug}/ and record counts. Today: hotels in Andorra.
